system.description:
Smarts or Strange; 3 Shock or Fire; Long (150 ft). Highly Flammable: a Fire hit's save is a CR 2 Luck Check, and failing it gives Burning (2) rather than Burning (1). Electrocute: Shock damage is doubled against a target standing in water.

SHIVER Core Rulebook p.145
